description.value: MEC Bike Shop is the dedicated bicycle shop within the MEC (Mountain Equipment Co-op) Victoria store on Government Street in downtown Victoria. As part of a large Canadian outdoor retailer, the bike shop sits alongside camping, hiking, and touring gear, making it a convenient one-stop for cycle-tourists needing both bike services and trail supplies. A pump is confirmed on-site via OSM.
